notes.title: minor gameplay changes and bug fixes
notes.content:
Changes

 The shell now reflects projectiles in the direction you aim
 fixes glitch with dash hitbox not working properly if dash button is pressed twice

notes.title: SAGE demo feedback patch
notes.content:
bug fixes 


 a bug with 1-3 collectible letters disappearing has been fixed
 spike wall now works properly and kills players even during i-frames



gameplay changes 


 thunder dash now has an 8-frame jump buffer when exiting a tunnel
 thunder dash now sets the dash timer to 23 frames of dash time after entering a tunnel only if the player's dash timer is under 23 frames.
spike wall in 1-4 is now slower

notes.title: Dono's Tale update v0.02 (jul 6, 2022)
notes.content:

 Title screen music now plays when starting the game.
 options menu now works properly
 collectibles are now saved properly
 the camera does not follow Dono when he dies

 tutorial level music now loops properly

 Time trial mode
